_comment: What each sound is meant to be, in words a sound model understands: 'owner/event', or '*/event' for any owner without its own line. Used by tools/audit_sounds.py.
Barbs/whoosh: a short burst of thorns flying through the air
Barrier/barrier: a magical shield bubble forming, a soft shimmer
Obsidian Armor/barrier: stone armor forming around a body, a heavy hardening
Black Hole/dark_whoosh: a deep dark whoosh being sucked inward
Crimson Veil/glass: a glassy crack as a blow is negated
